notes: Specs are for the base IN1808 model (1U, no built-in control processor/amplifier). Extron also sells IN1808 IPCP SA and IN1808 IPCP MA 70 variants (2U) that add a built-in IPCP Pro 355M control processor, a 3-port AV LAN switch (3x RJ45), and a Class D power amplifier (4-pole 5mm captive screw for SA stereo/dual-mono, or 2-pole 5mm for MA70 70V mono) - those extra ports are omitted here since this entry targets the base switcher SKU. Rear-panel port identities/labels (callouts A-R) were confirmed from the Extron IN1808 Series Setup Guide (68-3131-51 Rev A) rear-panel diagram; electrical specs from the Extron IN1808 Series Specifications sheet (5597-D11, also reissued as 5944-D12). AC inlet is Extron's standard internal-PSU chassis inlet (typical IEC C14 for this product family); exact inlet sub-type not explicitly spelled out in the spec text, only shown in the rear-panel photo - medium certainty on this one detail. HDMI ports are HDMI 1.4/2.0 (18 Gbps max data rate), graded hdmi-2.0. DisplayPort input is DisplayPort 1.2 (21.6 Gbps SST). The RJ-45 DTP2/XTP ports carry Extron's proprietary AV-over-twisted-pair extension (video/audio/control), not general-purpose networking, but use the RJ45 connector id per the schema; graded eth-1g as the closest available bandwidth-class placeholder. The LAN port is genuine 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet. Loop Out is a non-scaled passthrough of input 6, physically a distinct HDMI connector.
